doc: Encores are the run-long rule changes drafted between rounds (the 'relic' slot). Each sets one flag read by Run.

running_gag.name: RUNNING GAG
running_gag.text: Chain multipliers start one step higher.

tight_five.name: TIGHT FIVE
tight_five.text: Draw one more card every round.

slow_clap.name: SLOW CLAP
slow_clap.text: Every 3rd prank to fire in a round fires twice.

full_house.name: FULL HOUSE
full_house.text: +20 Applause if all six stations fire.

second_banana.name: SECOND BANANA
second_banana.text: The first prank you rig each round is free.

tin_ear.name: TIN EAR
tin_ear.text: +4 Applause whenever a prank leaves a residue.

curtain_call.name: CURTAIN CALL
curtain_call.text: +6 Applause for each Nerve left unspent.

clean_sweep.name: CLEAN SWEEP
clean_sweep.text: +12 Applause to end a round with no residues on him.
